workflows.name: single_cell_trajectory_analysis
workflows.intent: Order single cells in pseudotime along a trajectory and perform differential expression and clustering.
workflows.stages: 1. Create a CellDataSet object using newCellDataSet ;; 2. Filter genes and detect expressed genes using detectGenes ;; 3. Classify or cluster cells using clusterCells or classifyCells ;; 4. Order cells along a trajectory using orderCells ;; 5.
